title: hieracium ulotrichum
intro: Hieracium ulotrichum, commonly known as woolly hawk's beard, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which may contribute to its antimicrobial and hepatoprotective effects. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Hieracium ulotrichum for medicinal use.
